label: Instructional Task 1
stem: Two straight lines, AC and BD, intersect at point E. Using the given angle ∠AEB, find the measure of the other 3 angles. This item may seem a bit challenging but it fits within the benchmark, because it can be solved by repeatedly using additivity, and that fact that a straight line is 180°.
